records.title: ISO general purpose screw threads — Basic profile
records.scope: Defines the basic profile for ISO metric screw threads.
records.public_summary: Used as profile geometry context for metric thread concepts and calculations.
records.copyright_note: No copyrighted standards text is reproduced; only public summary and reference metadata.

records.title: ISO general purpose metric screw threads — General plan
records.scope: Specifies preferred combinations of diameter and pitch for metric threads.
records.public_summary: Referenced for metric designation and pitch-plan context in engineering explanations.
records.copyright_note: No copyrighted standards text is reproduced; only public summary and reference metadata.

records.title: ISO general purpose metric screw threads — Selected sizes for screws, bolts, and nuts
records.scope: Lists selected preferred metric fine thread diameter and pitch combinations.
records.public_summary: Referenced for fine-pitch metric thread selection and designation consistency in engineering workflows.
records.copyright_note: No copyrighted standards text is reproduced; only public summary and reference metadata.

records.title: ISO general purpose metric screw threads — Basic dimensions
records.scope: Provides basic dimension framework for metric thread geometry.
records.public_summary: Referenced where pitch diameter and related geometry fields are discussed.
records.copyright_note: No copyrighted standards text is reproduced; only public summary and reference metadata.

records.title: ISO metric screw threads — Tolerances — Principles and basic data
records.scope: Defines tolerance principles, class notation, and fit interpretation context.
records.public_summary: Primary tolerance-class reference for 6H, 6g, zone interpretation, and allowance explanations. ISO 965-1:2013 (4th edition) was withdrawn; ISO 965-1:2026 (5th edition) is the current edition, published 2026-04-14. This record describes the standard's ongoing subject matter and is not tied to either edition's specific text.
records.copyright_note: No copyrighted standards text is reproduced; only public summary and reference metadata.

records.title: Drills for use prior to tapping screw threads
records.scope: Specifies recommended drill sizes for use before tapping ISO metric threads, ISO inch threads, and pipe threads, for screw threads of normal length of engagement.
records.public_summary: Reference standard for tap-drill (pilot-hole) sizing prior to tapping; drill diameter is approximately equal to nominal thread diameter minus pitch. Confirmed current, last reviewed by ISO in 2022.
records.copyright_note: No copyrighted standards text is reproduced; only public summary and reference metadata.

records.title: Ground thread taps for ISO metric threads of tolerances 4H to 8H and 4G to 6G, coarse and fine pitches — Manufacturing tolerances on the threaded portion
records.scope: Specifies manufacturing tolerances on the threaded portion of ground thread taps for ISO metric threads, applicable to short taps per ISO 529 and other ground thread taps of the same diameters and pitches.
records.public_summary: Reference standard for ground-tap manufacturing tolerance context; concerns the tap tool's own manufacturing tolerances, not tap-drill hole sizing. Confirmed current with 2 amendments (1984, 1986), last reviewed by ISO in 2022.
records.copyright_note: No copyrighted standards text is reproduced; only public summary and reference metadata.
